resolutions.title: The verify-pass scenario's example names the v4 command while the shipped schema is v5
resolutions.action: Restated the example under spec-driven v5: with nothing covering the first system slot (`invoked`), the default review preference presents the pair command, so the graph's lead is `/orbit:review --as system --reviewer blind-pair foo`, which systemReviewNext passes through. The scenario's rule, that the lead is the graph's command and never a literal, is unchanged, and so is its title (the scenario-map key). A prose repair in a baseline scenario's example, as the 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-05 project walks made.
